# Heteroskedasticity

::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives
- Understand what heteroskedasticity is and why it arises in practice
- Recognize how heteroskedasticity affects statistical inference
- Learn how robust standard errors address heteroskedasticity
:::

::: {.callout-important}
### Key Takeaways
- Heteroskedasticity does not bias OLS coefficients
- Standard errors are incorrect under heteroskedasticity if not adjusted
- Robust standard errors provide valid inference in many applications
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### Common Pitfalls
- Believing heteroskedasticity biases coefficient estimates
- Ignoring heteroskedasticity when conducting hypothesis tests
- Treating robust standard errors as a solution to model misspecification
:::

Why heteroskedasticity matters in applied econometrics.
